facts_found: Gold Account earns a flat base APY of 5.5% on the maintained balance; no balance-based APY tiers are documented for Gold. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_001]

Gold Account interest compounds daily (each day's accrual based on current balance plus previously accrued interest) and is credited monthly as a separate statement line item. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_010]
Gold Account requires a $10,000 minimum balance ($10.00 monthly fee if breached); the minimum drops to $5,000 for Gold Rewards Card holders. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_001]

Only Green Account checking (+0.75%) and Purple Account checking (+0.1%) provide a linked-checking APY boost on a Gold savings account; other checking pairings give no boost. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_012]

When a customer holds multiple qualifying checking accounts, the boosts do NOT stack; only the highest applicable checking boost is applied (e.g., Green +0.75% beats Purple +0.1%). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046]

Gold Account credit-card APY bonuses: EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards +0.35%, Diamond Elite +0.3%, Silver Rewards +0.2%, Bronze Rewards +0.15%, Platinum Rewards +0.15%, Gold Rewards +0.025%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]
When a customer holds multiple credit cards, the APY bonuses do NOT stack; only the highest card bonus is applied. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

Checking boosts, credit-card bonuses, relationship bonuses, and tier bonuses DO stack with one another across categories (only within-category stacking is prohibited). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

Gold Rewards Card holders receive a +0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the 5.5% base (note: the source document's worked example incorrectly states 5.5% + 0.025% = 6.0%; the additive result should be 5.525%). [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013]
Gold Plus Account pays 6.0% APY on eligible balances (minimum balance $25,000, opening deposit $10,000). [doc_savings_accounts_gold_plus_account_002]
Platinum Account pays 6.5% APY and requires a $50,000 minimum balance to retain benefits. [doc_savings_accounts_platinum_account_001]
Platinum Plus Account pays 7.0% APY and requires a $100,000 minimum balance. [doc_savings_accounts_platinum_plus_account_006]
Diamond Elite Account pays 7.5% APY with daily compounding and monthly crediting. [doc_savings_accounts_diamond_elite_account_010]

To correct an underpaid interest amount, the agent must first apply a credit via apply_savings_account_credit_6831 and then submit an interest discrepancy report via submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044]

open_questions: Exact day-count convention / daily periodic rate formula for Gold is not stated beyond 'compounds daily', so the precise expected monthly interest for $96,000 cannot be computed from the KB alone.

Validating whether $450 is correct requires the customer's actual daily balance history and statement-cycle length (must be retrieved via get_bank_account_transactions_9173 / account lookup, not in KB).
Diamond Elite Account minimum balance requirement was not retrieved (only its 7.5% APY).

No Gold-specific generic 'multiple Rho-Bank products' relationship bonus was documented independent of the Gold Rewards Card; the only documented Gold relationship bonus (+0.025%) is tied to holding a Gold Rewards Card.
Internal inconsistency in doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013 (5.5% + 0.025% shown as 6.0%) should be treated with caution.

facts_found: get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is the internal agent tool used to retrieve a customer's bank accounts (checkings and savings). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 requires only the customer's user_id as its parameter. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 returns all account information including account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, and date_opened. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

Documented uses of get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 include checking eligibility for opening new accounts (status, balances, tenure, number of accounts), verifying pre-closure requirements, and looking up account details for customer service inquiries. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

The interest-discrepancy procedure directs agents to look up the customer's accounts with get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 and then check transaction history with get_bank_account_transactions_9173 to find the interest credit. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044]

For interest corrections, agents must verify account details and APY components using get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 and confirm the credited interest amount via get_bank_account_transactions_9173. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_043]

get_bank_account_transactions_9173 takes account_id (the bank account ID) and returns all transactions for that account in reverse-chronological order, with fields transaction_id, account_id, date (MM/DD/YYYY), description, amount (USD; positive = credit, negative = debit), type, and status (posted/pending). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

The 'interest_credit' transaction type is one of the documented values returned in bank account transaction history, which is how a credited savings interest line item is identified. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

The account lookup tool returns account_type and account_class separately, so savings vs. checking classification and the specific product name (e.g., 'Gold Account', 'Green Account') are both available from the same call. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

open_questions: The KB document for get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 does not state whether the tool must first be enabled via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool / invoked via call_discoverable_agent_tool, or whether it can be called directly.

The KB does not document the exact enum values returned in the account_type field (e.g., 'checking'/'savings') or the allowed status values for bank accounts, although 'ACTIVE'/'OPEN' statuses are referenced by other procedures.
The customer's actual user_id value is not in the KB and must come from the session context.

The KB does not state whether get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 returns closed accounts or supports filtering by account_type; filtering by account_type/account_class must be done client-side on the returned list.

facts_found: Gold Account base APY is 5.5%. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_004]

Gold Account interest compounds daily (each day's accrual on current balance plus previously accrued interest) and is credited monthly as a separate statement line item. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_010]
Gold Account credit-card APY bonuses include EcoCard +0.6% and Gold Rewards Card +0.025% (listed in the same credit-card bonus table). [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]

Credit-card APY bonuses do NOT stack; only the highest card bonus applies. The policy's worked example states that a customer holding Gold Rewards (+0.025%), Platinum Rewards (+0.15%), and EcoCard (+0.6%) receives only the EcoCard +0.6%, not the sum. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]
Credit-card bonuses DO stack with checking-account boosts and with relationship bonuses (different categories). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

Checking-account APY boosts do NOT stack; only the highest applies. For a Gold savings account holding Green (+0.75%) and Purple (+0.1%) checking, only the Green +0.75% boost applies. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046]
Green checking boosts a linked Gold savings account by +0.75% APY. [doc_checking_accounts_green_account_(checking)_001]

doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013 describes the Gold Rewards +0.025% as a 'relationship bonus APY on top of the base 5.5%' (its worked example erroneously sums 5.5%+0.025% to 6.0%; correct additive result is 5.525%). This labeling conflicts with doc_014/general_045, which treat +0.025% as a credit-card bonus. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013]

Derived effective APY under the controlling stacking rules = 5.5% + 0.75% (Green) + 0.6% (EcoCard) = 6.85%; the Gold Rewards +0.025% is superseded by EcoCard and is not added. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

The KB never states the explicit daily periodic rate formula (e.g., (1+APY)^(1/365)-1 vs APY/365) nor the day-count convention; it only says a daily rate is 'derived from'/'converted from' the APY and applied to the end-of-day balance. [doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_006]
No document specifies the Gold Account statement-cycle start/end dates; the only observed credit date is 10/31/2025. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_003]

Pre-credit October balance inferred as $95,550 ($96,000 current holdings minus the $450 interest credit posted 10/31/2025, with no other October transactions). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

Estimated October interest at 6.85% APY over 31 days on $95,550 using the standard APY-to-daily convention is about $539, implying the $450 credit is underpaid by roughly $89. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_004]

Interest-correction procedure: verify APY components, compute expected vs actual, then apply a credit via apply_savings_account_credit_6831 BEFORE submitting submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 (which takes expected_apy, actual_apy, amount_difference). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044]

Gold Account statement-cycle start and end dates (only the 10/31/2025 credit date is known); cycle length needed for exact accrual.
Verified daily end-of-day balance history for October (must be retrieved via get_bank_account_transactions_9173 / account lookup) to confirm the $95,550 principal assumption.
The actual_apy the system applied (needed for submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294) is not directly documented; only inferable from the $450 credit.
Resolution of the KB conflict on whether Gold Rewards +0.025% is a card bonus (superseded by EcoCard → 6.85%) or a separate relationship bonus (stacks → 6.875%).

facts_found: To correct an underpaid interest amount, the agent must first apply a credit via apply_savings_account_credit_6831 and then submit an interest discrepancy report via submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044]
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is the internal agent tool used to retrieve a customer's bank accounts (checkings and savings). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 requires only the customer's user_id as its parameter. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 returns all account information including account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, and date_opened. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

Documented uses of get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 include checking eligibility for opening new accounts (status, balances, tenure, number of accounts), verifying pre-closure requirements, and looking up account details for customer service inquiries. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

The interest-discrepancy procedure directs agents to look up the customer's accounts with get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 and then check transaction history with get_bank_account_transactions_9173 to find the interest credit. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044]

For interest corrections, agents must verify account details and APY components using get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 and confirm the credited interest amount via get_bank_account_transactions_9173. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_043]

get_bank_account_transactions_9173 takes account_id (the bank account ID) and returns all transactions for that account in reverse-chronological order, with fields transaction_id, account_id, date (MM/DD/YYYY), description, amount (USD; positive = credit, negative = debit), type, and status (posted/pending). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

The 'interest_credit' transaction type is one of the documented values returned in bank account transaction history, which is how a credited savings interest line item is identified. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

The account lookup tool returns account_type and account_class separately, so savings vs. checking classification and the specific product name (e.g., 'Gold Account', 'Green Account') are both available from the same call. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]
Gold Account base APY is 5.5%. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_004]

Gold Account interest compounds daily (each day's accrual on current balance plus previously accrued interest) and is credited monthly as a separate statement line item. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_010]
Gold Account credit-card APY bonuses include EcoCard +0.6% and Gold Rewards Card +0.025% (listed in the same credit-card bonus table). [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_014]

Credit-card APY bonuses do NOT stack; only the highest card bonus applies. The policy's worked example states that a customer holding Gold Rewards (+0.025%), Platinum Rewards (+0.15%), and EcoCard (+0.6%) receives only the EcoCard +0.6%, not the sum. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]
Credit-card bonuses DO stack with checking-account boosts and with relationship bonuses (different categories). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

Checking-account APY boosts do NOT stack; only the highest applies. For a Gold savings account holding Green (+0.75%) and Purple (+0.1%) checking, only the Green +0.75% boost applies. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046]
Green checking boosts a linked Gold savings account by +0.75% APY. [doc_checking_accounts_green_account_(checking)_001]

doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013 describes the Gold Rewards +0.025% as a 'relationship bonus APY on top of the base 5.5%' (its worked example erroneously sums 5.5%+0.025% to 6.0%; correct additive result is 5.525%). This labeling conflicts with doc_014/general_045, which treat +0.025% as a credit-card bonus. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013]

Derived effective APY under the controlling stacking rules = 5.5% + 0.75% (Green) + 0.6% (EcoCard) = 6.85%; the Gold Rewards +0.025% is superseded by EcoCard and is not added. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045]

The KB never states the explicit daily periodic rate formula (e.g., (1+APY)^(1/365)-1 vs APY/365) nor the day-count convention; it only says a daily rate is 'derived from'/'converted from' the APY and applied to the end-of-day balance. [doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_006]
No document specifies the Gold Account statement-cycle start/end dates; the only observed credit date is 10/31/2025. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_003]

Pre-credit October balance inferred as $95,550 ($96,000 current holdings minus the $450 interest credit posted 10/31/2025, with no other October transactions). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018]

Estimated October interest at 6.85% APY over 31 days on $95,550 using the standard APY-to-daily convention is about $539, implying the $450 credit is underpaid by roughly $89. [doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_004]
